legend: The self-maintaining haematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) in the bone marrow give rise to common monocyte progenitors (cMoPs) and common dendritic cell (DC) precursors (CDPs). CDPs differentiate into either conventional DCs (cDC1, cDC2) or plasmacytoid DCs (pDCs). Monocytes can further differentiate into monocyte-derived cells, macrophages, and DCs under certain conditions. Macrophages originally present in tissues have an embryonic origin and maintain themselves.
